id.description: Assignment unique identifier generated when the assignment is created.

roleId.description: Role unique identifier associated with this access control.

resourceId.description: Resource unique identifier associated with this access control.

domains.description: Domain identifiers associated with this access control.

name.description: Localized resource name in the form of a map of translations.

scopes.description: A list of resolved scopes for a particular access control.

restrictionAware.description: Determines whether this access control generates scopes with restriction suffixes when assigned to a group that has restrictions defined. When `true`, the generated scopes will include restrictions (e.g. order.`order_manage--DE`) based on the group's restrictions list. When `false`, scopes are generated without restriction suffixes regardless of the group's restrictions.

restrictedTo.description:
Restricts the type of group this access control can be assigned to.
* `CUSTOMER` - the access control can be assigned only to groups of `CUSTOMER` user type.
* `EMPLOYEE` - the access control can be assigned only to groups of `EMPLOYEE` user type.

If this property is not present, the access control can be assigned to any group regardless of its user type.

predefined.description: Indicated whether this access control is predefined in the system or was created by a user.

vendorAware.description: Indicated whether this access control is associated with vendor scopes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the access control was created.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the access control was last modified.

id.description: Resource unique identifier generated when the resource is created.

name.description: Localized resource name in the form of a map of translations.

description.description: Localized resource description in the form of a map of translations.

ResourceQueryDocument.description: Resource definition associated with this access control.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the resource was created.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the resource was last modified.

applicablePermissionResources.description: Allows you to allowlist resources that the permission is applicable to. Can only contain resources specified in the permission document under `applicableResources`.

id.description: Reference to the permission document with specific resources defined.

RoleQueryDocument.description: Role definition associated with this access control.

id.description: Role unique identifier generated when the role is created.

name.description: Localized role name in the form of a map of translations.

description.description: Localized role description in the form of a map of translations.

permissions.description: Permissions unique identifier list declared for this role.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the role was created.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the role was last modified.
